name: Fact Tile
job: Give one fact a label, a figure and a short caption, with the label outside the box so a row of tiles reads as one aligned band.

anatomy.role: Above the box, left-aligned with its edge, 4px gap; mono-free sans caps, 0.75rem bold
Drawn behind the figure and caption rows only (a `::before` on the subgrid), so the label sits outside it
Headline size, bold, tabular figures, 12px from the box top
0.9rem, 6px under the figure, 12px from the box bottom
A `.ftiles-c` container (container queries) holding the grid of tiles; each tile spans three subgrid rows so labels, figures and captions line up across the row

states.name: Four tiles
states.note: One column when narrow, two by two from a 28rem container, one row from 54rem, so no tile sits alone on a row. Container queries, so the tiles fit any column they are placed in.

states.name: Two tiles, uneven captions
states.note: Subgrid keeps the figures level even when one caption wraps to two lines.

use_when: A handful of headline facts (price, length, start, what you get) read better side by side than in a sentence.
Use four or two tiles so the breakpoints never leave an orphan; inside a summary disclosure, three or more fit with `auto-fit`.
avoid_when: Do not repeat a fact the next block already states; drop the tile instead.
Do not use it for a probability or a stat with a source line; that is 29 Tile (kept unchanged for its four consumers).
Do not put the label inside the box or right-align it.

data.note: Label is one or two words; figure is short (`$4,800`, `5 days`); caption is one plain line.

access: A `ul` with an `aria-label` (such as `Step 1 at a glance`); each tile is an `li` reading label, figure, caption in order.
All sizes are rem and the row uses `minmax(0,1fr)`, so the largest text size and roomy spacing wrap inside the box instead of overflowing.
Contrast: label `cyan` and caption `text-secondary` are AA on `surface` in both themes.

used_by.name: Approved My Ally Step 1 template (public/myally-hub.html, PR 2094)

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check` (in scripts): every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
Reading-options check: 375 and 1280, light and dark, largest text size, roomy spacing and the easy-read font.
